objective: Keep unresolved discovery pages, partial document reads, and candidate-closure obligations salient until the agent reconciles them.

changes.failure_pattern: Agents repeatedly saw explicit truncation or partial-read metadata, or surfaced a candidate and its proof path, but lost that open coverage state across later turns and drafted before candidate closure.
changes.mechanism: Track exact covered intervals for read, glob, and grep results in trial-local state; remove an item only when its intervals cover the complete reported range; and place one replaceable end-of-history reminder listing open ranges plus the candidate-to-proof-to-draft reconciliation action.
changes.rationale: C1 and C2 already made pagination, source identity, and completion metadata explicit, yet 54 independent diagnoses still show noncompliance with that prompt-level protocol. Middleware is the smallest stronger surface that can preserve those deterministic tool facts across turns without deciding legal relevance, blocking finish, or changing tool semantics.

validation: Python syntax and agent registration checks
